fusions.name: Overdrawn Heave
fusions.desc: Looses an overdrawn arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Stave Clout
fusions.desc: Clubs an enemy beside you with the stave for 5 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Branch Swing
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Coiled Shoulders
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
